page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.large belongs to the High Clock Speed instance family and operates on the KVM hypervisor. The instance is powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a base clock speed of 3.1 GHz. Hardware resource allocation consists of 1 dedicated physical core hyperthreaded to provide 2 vCPUs, paired with 8.0 GB of system memory, matching a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio. Cache resources include 32 KB of L1 data cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 35 MB of shared L3 cache. Architectural instruction support includes AVX, AVX-512F, AVX-512 VNNI, and AES hardware acceleration.

The hardware configuration includes no integrated local storage, requiring network-attached block storage for persistent data, and features no dedicated GPU accelerators. Baseline network throughput is provisioned at 1 Gbps with no complimentary public IPv4 addresses included. Benchmark evaluations indicate respectable single-threaded performance offset by modest aggregate throughput due to the dual-vCPU ceiling. Geekbench single-core reached 1263.0 and stress-ng single-core registered 1430.89, both ranking in the middle tier. In contrast, multi-threaded results, including Geekbench multi-core at 1512.0 and PassMark CPU at 2354.16, fall into the lower performance decile. Memory bandwidth benchmarked at 13.81 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads and 12.07 GB/sec for writes.

From a cost efficiency standpoint, ecs.hfg6.large provides an accessible entry tier for applications requiring high base frequency without the overhead of unused core counts. The balanced memory profile supports modest operating system footprints and memory allocations, but throughput constraints on multi-core operations and Redis throughput of 1.86 million operations per second make it suboptimal for heavy caching layers or parallel computing. Optimal workloads include lightweight web servers, single-threaded processing tasks, basic build pipelines, and utility microservices.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.large is an entry-level x86_64 instance from the High Clock Speed family, powered by a 3.1 GHz Intel Xeon 8269CY processor with 1 physical core and 2 dedicated vCPUs. It features 8.0 GB of RAM, a 35 MB L3 cache, and instruction support for AVX-512 and AES encryption. The instance does not include integrated local storage or GPU accelerators, relying on a 1 Gbps baseline network interface. Benchmark results indicate balanced single-core execution with a Geekbench single-core score of 1263.0 and gzip compression at 24.91 GB/sec, contrasted with limited multi-core throughput due to its dual-thread hardware profile. It offers an efficient compute allocation for low-concurrency, clock-sensitive tasks such as lightweight web serving, background processing, and development microservices.
